title: Certify a proposed action without learning its hidden matrix
statement: Joint Loewner concavity and Q>=mI imply convex Z=eTQ^-1e, concave G and 0<=Zii<=Mi=||e||²(2Li²/m³+Bi/m²). With reciprocal intervals[a0,b0] at x and[ai,bi] at x+hi ei, use l_i=(a0-bi)/hi-ci, h_i=(b0-ai)/hi-ci+Mi hi/2.

requires: Uniformly SPD jointly Loewner-concave C2 Q with stated m,Li,Bi and ||e|| bounds; calibrated stable R=3/2+1/Z and valid bounded-error reaction intervals at x and each x+hi ei. Dose margin is required. Reuse matching already-paid intervals under the same source/dose/reset/calibration contract; obtain missing points through a live resettable source. Monotone PSD actuation is an ADDITIONAL premise for clipping at -cost.
provides: Joint Loewner concavity and Q>=mI imply convex Z=eTQ^-1e, concave G and 0<=Zii<=Mi=||e||²(2Li²/m³+Bi/m²). With reciprocal intervals[a0,b0] at x and[ai,bi] at x+hi ei, use l_i=(a0-bi)/hi-ci, h_i=(b0-ai)/hi-ci+Mi hi/2.
assumptions: Finite success does not establish global concavity. An old matrix or expired source does not supply missing reaction values; valid matching intervals can be reused without a new preparation.
costs: Consumes n+1 scalar reaction values (129 for128 controls). Reuse an already-paid valid value at the same dose point under the same stable source/reset/calibration contract; charge each newly queried point once, plus actual proposal, screening, calibration, reset and refinement costs. No510-reading prerequisite or general source-expiry capability.

Charge actual input/representation/source acquisition, calibration, all trials, arithmetic/bit/storage, preprocessing and failed work, preparation/reset/elapsed time/energy/loss/full cycle. Equally informed ordinary methods may adopt the same operation; no practical advantage established.
contract.units: R is a native scalar and Z=1/(R-3/2). Doses, reward and actuator prices retain the declared source normalization. Exact rational/field operations are not measured sensor precision.
contract.obstruction: Finite success does not establish global concavity. An old matrix or expired source does not supply missing reaction values; valid matching intervals can be reused without a new preparation. Acquire actual source/physical/control/noise contracts and full-cycle comparative costs. Missing numerical code/data remain unacquired; no device or practical advantage established.

body: Consume n+1 sound scalar reaction values with sum x<=delta-max hi. Matching valid cached values suffice; query missing points from the live source. Reciprocal conversion requires r-epsilon>3/2; otherwise return UNKNOWN. Inversion antitonicity/operator convexity proves shape transfer; integrate the bounded second derivative, then apply U1089-simplex-tangent-regret. Preserve the raw lower endpoint unless separately warranted monotonicity permits clipping. New prices shift the gradient bounds by the known linear cost without changing the cached source values.
